title: Front Door & Shutter Painting | Gainesville & Ocala FL
description: Front door, garage door, and shutter painting in Gainesville, Ocala, and North Central Florida. Hardware removed, sprayed enamel, heat-safe dark colors.
h1: Front Door, Garage Door, and Shutter Painting
heroIntro: Smooth sprayed enamel on entry doors, garage doors, and shutters, with hardware removed and reinstalled, and colors chosen to survive the afternoon sun on Florida facades.

body: Your front door is the most looked-at surface on the house, and shutters frame every window on the facade. Fresh color on just these pieces can change a home's curb appeal more than any other single project. Front door and shutter painting is also a good choice when the body of the house is in fine shape but the accents have faded, chalked, or peeled.

Because these are close-up, high-touch surfaces, the bar is higher than on siding. A brush-marked door or drips on a shutter louver are obvious from the walkway. We aim for a finish that looks factory-applied.

Knobs, deadbolts, kick plates, and knockers come off rather than getting masked. The door is cleaned, deglossed, and sanded; dents and cracks in wood doors are filled; and bare spots are primed. On fiberglass and steel doors, a bonding primer suited to the material is used.

We spray a waterborne urethane enamel, which levels smoothly, cures hard, and resists the fingerprints and scuffs an entry door collects. Glass panes and weatherstripping are protected. The door is allowed to cure before hardware goes back on so nothing sticks to the jamb. Interior sides can be done in a matching or different color, and the frame and trim are often refreshed at the same time.

Stained wood entry doors are a separate case. If you want to keep the wood grain rather than paint over it, the door is stripped or sanded, re-stained, and given an exterior-rated clear finish through our wood staining and finishing service.
bullets: Material-specific primer on wood, fiberglass, or steel
Sprayed enamel for a smooth, brush-free finish
Frame, casing, and threshold trim painted to match

body: Black, navy, and deep green doors are popular, but on a south- or west-facing entry they can get extremely hot. Dark colors absorb heat, which can soften some coatings, warp vinyl components, and speed fading. On those elevations we specify heat-reflective or vinyl-safe formulations designed to stay stable under heat, and we will tell you plainly if a particular door and exposure is a poor match for a very dark color.
Our blog post on painting trim and shutters covers more on color choices for accents, and our color consultation can help you test door colors against your body and trim.

Wood shutters are cleaned, sanded, repaired, primed, and sprayed so paint reaches into every louver without building up in corners. Vinyl and composite shutters can be painted with vinyl-safe products after thorough cleaning; color choice matters here, since going much darker than the original can cause warping. Shutters can be removed and sprayed off the wall or painted in place, depending on how they are fastened and their condition.

Garage doors are large and highly visible. Steel doors are washed, scuffed, and spot-primed where rust or bare metal shows, then sprayed or rolled in exterior acrylic. Window inserts and weather seals are protected, and the door is cycled so the panel joints are fully covered. A new finish on the garage door pairs well with a garage floor coating inside.

Accent surfaces also show wear sooner than the walls around them. Doors take hands, keys, and pets; shutters take wind-driven rain on every face. A quick inspection every year or two, plus the labelled touch-up paint we leave with you, keeps small chips from turning into bare wood or rust. When the finish does dull, a light cleaning and a single maintenance coat often brings it back without full prep.
Color matching is simple even if you have no record of the original. We can match from a paint chip, a removed shutter, or a leftover can, and show a full-size drawdown before spraying.

A door and shutter job is often a single short visit, and the entry stays secure since the door is usually painted in place or rehung the same day. These accents are also a common add-on to a full exterior painting project or a trim-only refresh through our trim and molding painting service. Your written estimate lists each door and shutter, the products, colors, and coats, and exterior work is backed by our written workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Can I have a black front door in Florida?
faqs.a: Often yes, using heat-reflective or vinyl-safe products. On doors with direct afternoon sun and vinyl parts, we may suggest a slightly lighter shade to prevent heat damage.

faqs.q: Do you remove the door to paint it?
faqs.a: Hardware always comes off. Many doors are painted in place with careful masking; some are removed and rehung the same day depending on the door and finish.
Yes, with vinyl-safe paint after a thorough cleaning. Avoid going much darker than the original color to prevent warping.

faqs.q: Can you paint my garage door?
faqs.a: Yes. Steel and wood garage doors are cleaned, primed where needed, and painted, with seals and windows protected.
